goals.2: Asking for the bill: Die Rechnung, bitte!
dialog.1.de.3.n: Hunger haben (literally: to have hunger) = to be hungry
dialog.6.de.1.n: Everyone says it before starting to eat
grammar.0.text: Where Bangla says “to get hungry” (“khide paoa”), German says „Hunger haben“ (to have hunger): Ich habe Hunger. Ich habe Durst. If you aren't hungry: Ich habe keinen Hunger (der Hunger → keinen). You can also say „Ich bin hungrig“, but „Ich habe Hunger“ is more common.
grammar.1.title: Two polite ways to order
grammar.1.text: „Ich nehme …“ (I'll take …) and „Ich möchte …“ (I would like …). Both take the Akkusativ: Ich nehme den Salat. / Ich möchte einen Salat. For drinks one phrase is enough: „Ein Wasser, bitte.“
grammar.2.title: Parts of the menu
quiz.6.why: It is said before the meal starts — “enjoy your meal”.
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order: “The bill, please!”
